lines: Gust took the plank out from under me on number four and I went down on the deck, not off it.
Nineteen years on the gantries and I have never once been surprised by the wind.
That is what is in this sling. Not the arm. The surprise.
Off a gantry. Not OFF off. On to it, hard, which is the good kind.
The bed by the window is for people who went off off. It has been empty since 1877.
Everybody who works up there knows the year. Nobody knows the name.
I came up from Aureline on the Tuesday ship to see my sister and now there is no Friday ship.
She says stay. I would like to stay. I would like it better if staying were a choice.
